answer: Ten years of bills, one account, every month on time. Utility bill payment tenure treats that record as the identity: bills paid from the same account for a decade. A farm would have to open a hundred accounts and pay a hundred sets of bills monthly, and the falcon that watches all of it is the bank ledger - silent, complete, and impossible to edit after the fact. Each fake needs its own anchor: a payment history with no gaps, no shortcuts, no backdating. The hollow at the centre is time itself - a decade cannot be fast-forwarded, so the hundredth fake costs exactly as much as the first.
